vulnerability.name: USN-6968-2
vulnerability.description: USN-6968-1 fixed CVE-2024-7348 in PostgreSQL-12, PostgreSQL-14, and PostgreSQL-16  This update provides the corresponding updates for PostgreSQL-9.5 in Ubuntu 16.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   Noah Misch discovered that PostgreSQL incorrectly handled certain  SQL objects. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute  arbitrary SQL functions as the superuser.

statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL could execute arbitrary SQL functions as the superuser if it received a specially crafted SQL object. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
